title: Frontend: Largest number formed
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Largest number formed. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values) for nonnegative integer strings. Arrange them to form the largest concatenation and return it as a string. An all-zero result becomes 0, empty input becomes an empty string.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Sort strings using the order of a+b versus b+a rather than ordinary numeric value or first digit alone.
alternativeApproaches: Explain why the pairwise concatenation comparator establishes the required ordering and keep arithmetic precision out of the comparison.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All zeros; 3 vs 30; common prefixes.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
